info.name: KanMind API
info.description:
Tests for all endpoints of the KanMind endpoint documentation.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner): the requests register three users (A = owner, B = member, C = outsider) and pass tokens and ids via collection variables. Start the backend with `python manage.py runserver` first.

exec: pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['token', 'fullname', 'email', 'user_id'].sort()));
pm.test('fullname and email are returned', () => { pm.expect(json.fullname).to.eql('Postman User A'); pm.expect(json.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email_a')); });
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['token', 'fullname', 'email', 'user_id'].sort()));
pm.test('fullname and email are returned', () => { pm.expect(json.fullname).to.eql('Postman User B'); pm.expect(json.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email_b')); });
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['token', 'fullname', 'email', 'user_id'].sort()));
pm.test('fullname and email are returned', () => { pm.expect(json.fullname).to.eql('Postman User C'); pm.expect(json.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email_c')); });
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['token', 'fullname', 'email', 'user_id'].sort()));
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'email', 'fullname'].sort()));

pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'member_count', 'ticket_count', 'tasks_to_do_count', 'tasks_high_prio_count', 'owner_id'].sort()));

pm.test('counters and owner_id are correct', () => { pm.expect(json.member_count).to.eql(2); pm.expect(json.ticket_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(json.tasks_to_do_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(json.tasks_high_prio_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(json.owner_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('user_a_id'))); });

request.description: POST /api/boards/ - the requesting user becomes the owner.

exec: pm.test('contains the created board with documented fields', () => { const board = json.find(b => b.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('board_id'))); pm.expect(board).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Object.keys(board).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'member_count', 'ticket_count', 'tasks_to_do_count', 'tasks_high_prio_count', 'owner_id'].sort()); });
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'owner_id', 'members', 'tasks'].sort()));

pm.test('members have id, email and fullname', () => { pm.expect(json.members.length).to.eql(2); json.members.forEach(m => pm.expect(Object.keys(m).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'email', 'fullname'].sort())); });
pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'owner_data', 'members_data'].sort()));

pm.test('owner_data and members_data are returned', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(json.owner_data).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'email', 'fullname'].sort()); pm.expect(json.members_data.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(json.title).to.eql('Postman Board (renamed)'); });

request.description: PATCH /api/boards/{board_id}/ - members not listed are removed.

exec: pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'description', 'status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'reviewer', 'due_date', 'comments_count', 'board'].sort()));

pm.test('assignee and reviewer are user objects', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(json.assignee).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'email', 'fullname'].sort()); pm.expect(json.assignee.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('user_b_id'))); pm.expect(json.reviewer.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('user_a_id'))); pm.expect(json.comments_count).to.eql(0); });

exec: pm.test('tasks have the documented fields', () => { pm.expect(json.tasks.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(Object.keys(json.tasks[0]).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'description', 'status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'reviewer', 'due_date', 'comments_count'].sort()); });

item.name: Get boards - counters reflect the task

exec: pm.test('ticket_count, to-do and high-prio counters are 1', () => { const board = json.find(b => b.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('board_id'))); pm.expect(board.ticket_count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(board.tasks_to_do_count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(board.tasks_high_prio_count).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('contains the task with documented fields', () => { const t = json.find(x => x.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('task_id'))); pm.expect(t).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Object.keys(t).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'description', 'status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'reviewer', 'due_date', 'comments_count', 'board'].sort()); });

pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'title', 'description', 'status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'reviewer', 'due_date'].sort()));

item.name: Update task - change of board is not allowed -> 400

exec: pm.test('Response has exactly the documented fields', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(json).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'created_at', 'author', 'content'].sort()));
pm.test('author is the full name of user B and content matches', () => { pm.expect(json.author).to.eql('Postman User B'); pm.expect(json.content).to.eql('Das ist ein neuer Kommentar zur Task.'); });
pm.test('one comment with documented fields', () => { pm.expect(json.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(Object.keys(json[0]).sort()).to.have.members(['id', 'created_at', 'author', 'content'].sort()); });
